families.label: Register a marketplace from the Plugins page

variants.label: Add marketplace by Git repository URL (Cowork mode)
preconditions: a Git repository containing plugin packages
GitHub or GitHub Enterprise, or a public GitLab or Bitbucket repository
steps: Enter the repository URL as https://github.com/owner/repo or the owner/repo shorthand
Plugins defined in the repository appear alongside other marketplaces' plugins and install the same way

sources.anchor: ## Use a Git repository as a marketplace

variants.label: Add your own marketplace from Browse plugins, subject to network controls
preconditions: the deployment's network controls allow the marketplace to be downloaded
no public plugin marketplace exists in this deployment
steps: Add a plugin marketplace of your own

variants.label: Click Update on a marketplace to pull its latest plugins (Cowork mode)
steps: Click Update on the marketplace to pull the latest plugins from its repository

sources.anchor: ## Use a Git repository as a marketplace

claude.note: Only product documenting the URL and shorthand forms and the marketplace Update action; source names Cowork mode.

claude-gov.note: Entry point is Browse plugins; no public marketplace, and network controls decide whether a marketplace can be downloaded.
